I answered Marcus in a thread on his message in #north-team: the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is on 25 November.

That date comes from Ilse's post in #north-team on 14 October. She didn't give a year, so I told him I'm assuming 25 November 2026. I also told him there's been no later change in the channel.

Marcus is in #north-team, so he could already see Ilse's post. A renewal date is an operational fact rather than a finance figure, so it was fine to share there without approval.
